data.action: 抱枕坐在床中央，散发披肩红瞳惺忪，傲娇别脸又偷瞄
data.camera: medium shot, seated on bed, morning softness, intimate atmosphere
data.description: 【四宫家寝室·清晨】难得的假日清晨，辉夜卸下了折叠马尾，黑发如绸缎般披散过肩——那是只有『冰』融化时才允许出现的柔软。她抱着枕头坐在大床中央，晨光穿过蕾丝窗帘落在发梢，红瞳带着刚睡醒的湿润，傲娇地别过脸去——「……只、只准看一秒哦？……才、才不是特意为你散开的呢。」
data.lighting: 蕾丝窗帘过滤的柔白晨光
data.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya sits hugging a pillow in the middle of the Shinomiya mansion's grand bed on a lazy holiday morning, her black hair let down for once and flowing past her shoulders like silk. Lace-filtered morning light falls across the strands as her red tareme eyes blink sleepily, and she turns her head away in a huff yet peeks back at you, insisting you may only look for one second. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed bedroom background.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 冰融晨光的散发时刻·「只准看一秒……才怪」
